name: Sewer Gnawer
notes: Send them in packs of five or more and have them scatter when half are dead.
desc: A rat the size of a dog with yellow teeth and a bare tail. It darts in to bite and runs back into the dark.

name: Mange Hound
notes: It goes for whoever stands furthest from the group.
desc: A thin grey dog with patches of raw skin. It knocks a hunter over and holds on.

name: Tunnel Boar
notes: It charges in a straight line on its first turn and then fights where it stops.
desc: A low, heavy boar with tusks worn flat from digging. It charges once and then gores whatever is closest.

name: Carrion Crow Flock
notes: Treat the flock as one body that never stays next to a hunter for two turns.
desc: A wheeling mass of black crows that moves as one. It dives at faces and lifts away before a blade can reach it.

name: Ditch Viper
notes: It waits hidden in water or grass and strikes the first hunter who passes.
desc: A mud coloured snake as long as a man is tall. It bites once from hiding and then tries to slip away.

name: Cave Bat Cluster
notes: It stays near the ceiling and only comes down to feed on a hunter who is alone.
desc: Hundreds of small bats that hang together like one dark cloth. Their screech rattles the nerves and they bite at anything that bleeds.

name: Bristle Hare
notes: It runs first and fights only when cornered.
desc: A hare as tall as a child with quills along its spine. It kicks hard enough to wind a grown hunter.

name: Lantern Beetle
notes: Its light gives away every creature near it, so other monsters keep their distance from it.
desc: A beetle the size of a shield with a glowing sac under its shell. It flares the sac to blind and then crawls off.

name: Rot Fly Cloud
notes: It drifts toward the wounded and ignores hunters at full health.
desc: A humming cloud of fat green flies. Each bite is small, but the bites fester within minutes.

name: Web Lurker
notes: It fights from the ceiling or a wall and never on open ground.
desc: A pale spider as wide as a cart wheel that hides above doorways. It ties a hunter down with web before it comes close.

name: Husk Maggot
notes: They come out of corpses already in the room, two or three to a body.
desc: A white grub as long as an arm with a ring of hooked teeth. It burrows out of dead things and bites the nearest leg.

name: Needle Wasp
notes: It keeps flying and stings a different hunter each turn.
desc: A wasp the size of a hawk with a stinger like a nail. It fires its stinger from the air and grows another.

name: Shambling Husk
notes: It walks straight at the nearest living thing and never retreats.
desc: A dried corpse in the rags of whatever it wore in life. It grabs and holds while others close in.

name: Bone Rattler
notes: It stays behind tougher undead and throws from there.
desc: A loose skeleton held together by old wire and habit. It pulls bones from its own chest and throws them.

name: Grave Crawler
notes: It hides under earth or rubble until a hunter steps over it.
desc: The top half of a corpse that drags itself by its hands. It bites at ankles and does not let go.

name: Drowned Deckhand
notes: It fights best in water and should be met at a shore or a flooded room.
desc: A bloated sailor with weed in his hair and a rusted hook. He coughs salt water into faces and swings the hook.

name: Tomb Candle
notes: It never moves from where it floats, and the dead near it fight harder to protect it.
desc: A skull with a pale flame burning inside it. The flame shows hunters their own deaths.

name: Soot Imp
notes: It taunts, throws fire and flies off when anyone gets close.
desc: A black, bat winged thing no taller than a boot. It flicks hot coals from its fingers and laughs.

name: Tallow Fiend
notes: It grabs one hunter and keeps hold of that one until it dies.
desc: A squat demon whose skin runs like candle wax. Its touch burns, and it likes to hold on.

name: Gutter Tempter
notes: It talks through the whole fight and aims its whispers at the strongest hunter.
desc: A small horned figure in a coat too fine for it. It talks hunters into fear or blind anger and lets others do the killing.

name: Clay Sentinel
notes: It guards one doorway and does not leave it.
desc: A man shaped figure of grey clay with a blank face. It strikes slowly and bakes its own skin hard when hurt.

name: Scrap Puppet
notes: Whatever built it is usually close by, so use it as a warning of something worse.
desc: A jointed doll of wire, tin and broken tools. It jerks about on unseen strings and throws rusty nails.

name: Rusted Watchman
notes: It follows an old patrol route and attacks anything on it.
desc: An empty suit of armour eaten brown by rust. It swings a long halberd and locks its joints when struck.

name: Straw Effigy
notes: Fire ends it quickly, and it knows this and stays away from torches.
desc: A scarecrow with a sack head and button eyes. It sticks pins into itself and a hunter feels each one.

name: Marsh Wisp
notes: It leads hunters toward other dangers and rarely fights alone.
desc: A ball of blue light that bobs over wet ground. It dulls the mind of anyone who watches it too long.

name: Cupboard Poltergeist
notes: It cannot leave the room it haunts.
desc: An unseen presence that shows only as moving objects. It throws whatever is loose at whoever is nearest.

name: Weeping Shade
notes: It attacks only those who come within reach of the place it died.
desc: A grey outline of a person with its face in its hands. Its sobbing fills a hunter with dread.

name: Cold Spot
notes: It has no body to see, so describe the breath fogging before it strikes.
desc: A patch of freezing air that drifts through a room. It numbs anything that stands in it.

name: Bog Lout
notes: It is slow to anger and slower to stop.
desc: A broad, stooped creature half again as tall as a man, caked in mud. It swings a tree branch in wide arcs.

name: Runt Ogre
notes: It was driven out by larger ogres and fights with a grudge.
desc: An ogre no bigger than a tall man, with a flat head and one bad eye. It throws rocks and then wades in with its fists.

name: Mud Drakeling
notes: It will not chase anyone out of its wallow.
desc: A wingless young drake the size of a pony, slick with mud. It spits thick muck and bites what gets stuck.

name: Ash Hatchling
notes: A parent may be near, so let the hunters wonder.
desc: A newly hatched dragon with soft grey scales. It coughs sparks more than flame, but the sparks catch.

name: Mine Kobold
notes: They set simple traps and fight from behind them.
desc: A small, scaled miner with a candle stuck to its cap. It slings stones from cover and runs through tunnels too tight to follow.

name: Gate Scavenger
notes: They want loot and will run if the fight turns.
desc: A person in patched leathers who robs the dead inside gates. They fight dirty with short knives.

name: Redcap
notes: It will not flee, because its cap must stay wet.
desc: A wiry old man with iron boots and a cap soaked red. He stabs with a pike and stamps on those who fall.

name: Cult Novice
notes: They fight to buy time for whoever leads them.
desc: A robed youth with fresh scars on both palms. They chant borrowed words that burn the mind.

name: Pit Brawler
notes: He picks the biggest hunter and ignores the rest.
desc: A scarred fighter with wrapped fists and no armour. He closes fast and aims for the head.

name: Thorn Creeper
notes: It looks like ordinary bramble until someone walks into it.
desc: A tangle of thorned vines that moves like a slow animal. It whips out and tears skin.

name: Spore Cap
notes: It bursts when killed, so hunters who stand close pay for it.
desc: A waist high mushroom with a swollen red cap. It puffs choking spores at anything that moves.

name: Strangle Vine
notes: It hangs from above and takes the last hunter in line.
desc: A thick green vine that drops from branches like a snake. It wraps a throat and pulls upward.

name: Cellar Slime
notes: Blades pass through it with little effect, so describe that plainly.
desc: A grey, shivering mass that fills the low part of a floor. It rolls over a foot or a leg and starts to dissolve it.

name: Tar Blob
notes: Fire makes it more dangerous before it kills it.
desc: A black lump of living tar that smells of smoke. It sticks hunters in place and then rolls over them.

name: Pebble Mite
notes: They gather in dozens and are a nuisance more than a threat.
desc: A fist sized stone with stubby legs and a crack for a mouth. It bites ankles and is hard to hurt.

name: Spark Mote
notes: It is drawn to metal armour before anything else.
desc: A crackling point of light that darts in sharp lines. It jumps to metal and shocks whoever wears it.

name: Puddle Sprite
notes: It cannot leave its water for more than a few steps.
desc: A small figure made of clear water that rises from a pool. It throws cold water that numbs the limbs.

name: Mud Eel
notes: It only attacks hunters who are standing in water.
desc: A fat brown eel as long as a spear. It shocks whatever wades past and bites while the prey is stiff.

name: Shore Pincer
notes: It pulls into its shell when hurt and waits for a careless hand.
desc: A crab as wide as a table with one claw larger than the other. It clamps on and does not open.

name: Leech Mass
notes: It comes apart under a hard blow and each part keeps crawling.
desc: A knot of black leeches that moves like one wet body. It fastens on and drinks.

name: Bramble Pixie
notes: They steal first and fight only when caught.
desc: A winged figure the size of a hand, dressed in leaves. It shoots thorns dipped in sap that brings on fever.

name: Eyeless Groper
notes: It finds hunters by sound, so quiet ones can walk past it.
desc: A pale, hairless thing with long arms and no face. It feels along the walls and seizes what it touches.

name: Twitching Lump
notes: It should feel like something that does not belong in the gate at all.
desc: A mound of flesh with too many small mouths. It makes a noise that should not come from a throat and thrashes when approached.

name: Warren Chief
notes: He always has kobolds with him and runs when the last one falls.
desc: The largest kobold of a mine, wearing a necklace of hunter badges. He directs his miners with whistles and fights from behind them.

name: Hollow Log Mother
notes: Her young keep hatching until she is dead.
desc: A swollen spider that fills a fallen tree, pale eggs clinging to her back. She bites with jaws like shears and her eggs burst into webbing.

name: Gravedigger Unburied
notes: He raises a husk from the ground at the start of each round until someone breaks his shovel arm.
desc: A tall corpse in a sexton's coat who carries the shovel he was buried with. He knocks hunters into the earth and the earth holds them.

name: King of the Midden
notes: Gnawers pour out of the walls while he lives.
desc: A rat as large as an ox, fat and scarred, sitting on a hill of refuse. He bites through armour and sprays filth at anything out of reach.

name: Bonfire Sprite
notes: It grows more violent as the fire it lives in spreads.
desc: A child sized figure of flame that dances in a great fire. It throws embers and sets the ground alight around it.

name: Barrow Wolf
notes: They circle and take turns, so no hunter faces only one.
desc: A lean black wolf with a white blaze on its chest. It bites at the backs of legs and waits for its pack to finish the work.

name: Quillback Bear
notes: It rears before it charges, which gives one round of warning.
desc: A brown bear with a mane of long quills down its spine. Anything that grapples it comes away bleeding.

name: Stoat of the Hedgerows
notes: It attacks whoever is already hurt.
desc: A weasel as long as a man, quick and narrow. It winds around a hunter and bites at the neck.

name: Ridge Ram
notes: It needs room to charge and is far weaker in a tight space.
desc: A mountain ram as tall as a horse, with horns curled twice around. It hits like a thrown boulder.

name: Marsh Heron Stalker
notes: It stands still for so long that hunters take it for a dead tree.
desc: A grey heron twice the height of a man. It strikes downward with a beak like a spear.

name: Gloom Lynx
notes: It attacks from a height and returns to it.
desc: A large cat with fur the colour of smoke and eyes that do not shine. It drops on its prey from branches or ledges.

name: Carrion Vulture
notes: It waits for someone to go down and then lands on them.
desc: A bald vulture with the wingspan of a fishing boat. It prefers prey that has already fallen.

name: Tunnel Mantis
notes: It holds perfectly still until prey is within one step.
desc: A grey mantis the height of a man with forelimbs like shears. It strikes once, very fast, and resets.

name: Bombard Beetle
notes: It turns its back to its enemy before it fires.
desc: A black and orange beetle the size of a barrel. It sprays a boiling liquid from its abdomen.

name: Silk Matron
notes: She wraps one hunter at a time and drags the wrapped one away.
desc: A bloated spider with a pattern like a face on her back. She binds prey in silk and bites when it cannot move.

name: Carapace Roller
notes: It rolls through a line of hunters and uncurls behind them.
desc: An armoured louse the size of a cart. It curls into a ball and rolls over whatever is in its way.

name: Blood Midge Swarm
notes: Wind or smoke drives it off faster than blades do.
desc: A red haze of biting midges that hangs over stagnant water. It leaves its prey pale and weak.

name: Burrowing Lancer
notes: It attacks from under the ground and the earth shakes a moment before.
desc: A long, segmented worm with a horn of hard chitin at its head. It comes up beneath a hunter horn first.

name: Draugr Oarsman
notes: They fight in a line, shoulder to shoulder, as they did in life.
desc: A swollen blue corpse in rotted mail, heavier than it looks. It swings a long axe and does not tire.

name: Gallows Hanger
notes: It hangs from a beam or branch and attacks those who walk beneath.
desc: A hanged man whose rope still trails from his neck. He throws the rope and it tightens on its own.

name: Plague Bearer
notes: Keep it near other monsters so the hunters must choose who to stand beside.
desc: A corpse covered in sores and wrapped in a burial sheet. Everything it touches sickens, and the sickness spreads.

name: Ossuary Archer
notes: It keeps the longest range it can and never closes.
desc: A skeleton in a rusted helm with a bow strung with sinew. It shoots arrows carved from thigh bones.

name: Wailing Widow
notes: She follows one hunter through the whole fight.
desc: A woman in mourning dress whose feet do not touch the floor. Her cry weakens the will and her touch chills the blood.

name: Lantern Jack
notes: He leads hunters off paths and fights only to keep them lost.
desc: A thin figure carrying a lantern that burns with no flame. The light blinds anyone who looks at it directly.

name: Ash Wraith
notes: It reforms in the nearest fire if the fire is left burning.
desc: A figure of drifting ash in the shape of someone who burned. It fills lungs and eyes with hot dust.

name: Threshold Guardian
notes: It attacks only those who try to pass it.
desc: A tall shape of grey mist in the outline of an armoured man. It stands in a doorway and strikes whoever crosses.

name: Brimstone Hound
notes: It tracks by scent and always finds whoever ran.
desc: A red skinned dog with smoke rising from its jaws. It breathes burning fumes and bites through the cloud.

name: Hook Fiend
notes: It hooks a hunter at the back and drags them forward.
desc: A thin demon with chains growing from its wrists, each ending in a hook. It pulls prey toward itself.

name: Debt Collector
notes: It marks one hunter and works on that one until the mark is paid.
desc: A grey, neat demon carrying a ledger bound in skin. It writes a name and the named hunter begins to suffer.

name: Cinder Maiden
notes: She stays close to her victims and trusts her fire to keep others away.
desc: A woman shaped demon with hair of slow flame. She burns by touch and scatters sparks when struck.

name: Gargoyle Rainspout
notes: It perches and waits, and a hunter who studies the statues may spot it.
desc: A stone creature with a wide mouth and stubby wings. It drops from a roof edge and turns back to stone when hurt.

name: Brass Hound
notes: It guards a place and returns there when nothing is left to bite.
desc: A dog of hammered brass with a hinge for a jaw. Once it bites it locks shut.

name: Kiln Golem
notes: It grows hotter each round it fights.
desc: A thick bodied figure of fired brick with a glow in its chest. Its fists scorch and it vents heat when crowded.

name: Clockwork Fencer
notes: It fights one opponent at a time and ignores all others.
desc: A slim figure of gears and thin plates holding a narrow sword. It lunges at full reach and steps back.

name: Marionette Soldier
notes: They march in step and break formation only when half are destroyed.
desc: A wooden soldier in chipped paint, as tall as a man. It marches in step with others like it and stabs in unison.

name: Hill Ogre
notes: It eats in the middle of a fight if something falls near it.
desc: A fat ogre twice a man's height carrying a club studded with stones. It sweeps wide and knocks several down at once.

name: Two Headed Ettin
notes: Its heads disagree, and a clever hunter can set one against the other.
desc: A giant with two heads that quarrel in two voices. Each head swings its own club.

name: One Eyed Herdsman
notes: He fights to protect his flock and stops if the flock is left alone.
desc: A cyclops in sheepskins with a sling the size of a hammock. He throws boulders from across a valley.

name: Cliff Wyvern
notes: It carries off the lightest hunter if it can.
desc: A two legged dragon with leathery wings and a barbed tail. It swoops, stings and tries to lift its prey.

name: Fen Drake
notes: It fights from water and drags prey under.
desc: A wingless, low bodied drake with green black scales. It breathes foul gas and bites what staggers.

name: Lindworm Whelp
notes: It guards something buried and will not be drawn away from it.
desc: A serpent bodied dragon with two short forelegs and no wings. It coils around prey and bites at leisure.

name: Gate Deserter
notes: He knows hunter tactics and goes for the healer first.
desc: A former hunter in dented armour with his badge filed off. He fights with training and no restraint.

name: Hedge Witch
notes: She would rather bargain than fight, and curses those who refuse.
desc: An old woman in a coat of sewn pockets, each holding something dead. She curses with a look.

name: Pale Rider's Scout
notes: He shoots once from hiding and moves before the reply.
desc: A hooded archer on foot, face painted white. He shoots barbed arrows and never stays in one place.

name: Bridge Troll Tollman
notes: He regenerates unless burned, and he will take gold in place of a fight.
desc: A long armed troll with moss on his shoulders who lives under a bridge. He demands a toll and breaks those who refuse.

name: Wicker Colossus
notes: It is set alight at the start and grows more dangerous as it burns down.
desc: A giant figure woven of willow with a cage for a chest. It puts hunters in the cage and burns with them inside.

name: Bog Shambler
notes: It is very hard to see in a marsh until it stands up.
desc: A heap of wet rot and reeds in the rough shape of a man. It folds itself over prey and presses down.

name: Screaming Root
notes: It attacks only when pulled up or stepped on.
desc: A forked root with a wrinkled face that lies just under the soil. Its scream stops hearts for a moment.

name: Honey Trap Bloom
notes: It does not move, so the fight is about getting a caught hunter out.
desc: A flower as wide as a room with petals like red tongues. Its scent draws prey in and its sap dissolves it.

name: Bile Pudding
notes: It splits in two when cut and each half is smaller.
desc: A yellow, quivering mass that eats through wood and leather. It lashes out with ropes of acid.

name: Mirror Jelly
notes: It is nearly invisible in still water.
desc: A clear jelly that shows a warped reflection of whatever stands near. It blinds with caught light and folds over the dazzled.

name: Gravel Hulk
notes: It falls apart when beaten and the gravel keeps twitching.
desc: A man shaped heap of loose stone held together by will. It hits with the weight of a rockslide.

name: Gust Dancer
notes: It never stops moving and cannot be pinned.
desc: A spinning column of air with leaves caught in it. It knocks hunters flat and is gone before they stand.

name: Frost Sprite
notes: It makes the ground slick wherever it has been.
desc: A small figure of ice crystals with a sharp, thin face. It freezes joints with a gesture.

name: Reed Nixie
notes: She sings from the water and the fight is to reach her.
desc: A green haired woman who sits among reeds with her feet in the stream. Her song holds a listener still while the water rises.

name: Hobthrush
notes: It is a house spirit turned spiteful and stops if offered a gift.
desc: A small, hairy man in a ragged shirt who lives in barns. He throws tools and spoils food and water.

name: Pond Hag
notes: She pulls victims under and holds them there, so the fight is on her bank.
desc: A long armed hag with skin the colour of pond scum and teeth like a pike. She drags children and hunters into deep water.

name: Brine Lurker
notes: It takes one hunter into the water and leaves with them.
desc: A squid as long as a rowing boat with hooked suckers. It reaches from the water and pulls.

name: Pike Elder
notes: It strikes from below and returns to deep water each time.
desc: A pike as long as a canoe, scarred and green with age. It strikes upward from the dark at great speed.

name: Thing in the Well
notes: It never leaves the well, and it uses the voices of those it has taken.
desc: Something pale at the bottom of a deep well, mostly arms. It calls up in familiar voices and reaches for whoever leans over.

name: Skin Thief
notes: It arrives looking like someone the party knows.
desc: A slick, red thing that wears the skin of its last victim. It cuts with a curved knife and takes what it cuts.

name: Mound King
notes: He never leaves his burial chamber and his guards rise again while he stands.
desc: A crowned corpse seated on a stone chair, gold on every finger. He orders his buried guards with a gesture and curses grave robbers.

name: Old Stag of the Thicket
notes: The forest fights with him, so add roots and thorns to the ground.
desc: A stag as tall as a house with moss hanging from its antlers. It throws hunters into the trees and tramples the fallen.

name: Furnace Imp Foreman
notes: He drives lesser imps with a whip and hides behind the forge.
desc: A squat demon in a leather apron with a whip of hot wire. He pours slag across the floor and whips his workers into a frenzy.

name: Dire Boar Sounder
notes: It charges the largest group and keeps running through it.
desc: A boar as tall as a horse with tusks like sickles and a ridge of black bristle. It runs through a line of hunters and turns for another pass.

name: Shrike Raptor
notes: It hangs its kills on thorns and defends that larder.
desc: A grey hawk with a wingspan wider than a wagon. It lifts small prey and drops it on larger prey.

name: Cave Lion Matriarch
notes: Her pride attacks from the sides while she holds the front.
desc: A heavy, pale lion with scars across her muzzle. She leads from the front and kills with one bite to the neck.

name: Glacier Elk
notes: It is calm unless approached, and then it does not stop.
desc: An elk with antlers of clear ice that never melt. A blow from them leaves frost in the wound.

name: Night Heron Swarm
notes: It attacks only in darkness and leaves if strong light is made.
desc: A flock of black herons that hunts after dusk. They fall one after another like thrown spears.

name: Ironhide Rhinoceros
notes: It sees poorly and charges at noise.
desc: A grey rhinoceros whose skin has hardened into overlapping plates. It tosses armoured hunters like straw.

name: Tree Viper Nest
notes: It lives in the canopy and falls on whoever shakes the tree.
desc: Dozens of thin green snakes woven together in the branches. They drop as one and each one bites.

name: Scythe Mantis
notes: It mirrors the movements of whoever it faces before it strikes.
desc: A green mantis taller than a rider on horseback, with forelimbs like scythes. It sways, waits and cuts twice in one motion.

name: Tunnel Wasp Queen
notes: Her workers defend her to the last and die when she does.
desc: A wasp the size of a warhorse with a swollen golden abdomen. She paralyses with her sting and drives prey mad with her scent.

name: Glass Scorpion
notes: It is very hard to see on sand or stone.
desc: A scorpion as long as a cart with a shell like cloudy glass. It holds with one claw and stings over its own back.

name: Corpse Fly Brood Lord
notes: It lays its eggs in the wounded, so anyone bleeding is its first target.
desc: A fly the size of a bull with a wet red head. It showers its young over a crowd and the bites carry disease.

name: Stone Borer
notes: It comes through walls and floors and leaves tunnels behind.
desc: A grub as thick as a tree trunk with a ring of teeth that grind rock. It eats through anything in front of it.

name: Ember Moth
notes: It is drawn to any flame the hunters carry.
desc: A moth as wide as a door with wings that smoulder at the edges. It shakes burning dust over whatever it flies above.

name: Barrow Wight
notes: It cannot cross its own threshold into daylight.
desc: A tall, withered corpse in a dead lord's armour, with cold light in its eyes. Its grip leaves the limbs heavy and weak.

name: Sexton of Ashes
notes: He buries the fallen during the fight and they rise on his side.
desc: A burned priest in the remains of his robes, carrying a bell with no clapper. When he raises the bell the air fills with ash.

name: Pale Knight Errant
notes: He offers single combat and keeps to it if it is accepted.
desc: A dead knight on foot in white armour gone grey. He still fights by the rules of the tourney.

name: Hunger Ghoul
notes: It eats what it paralyses, even while the fight goes on.
desc: A hunched, grey skinned eater of the dead with a jaw that opens too wide. Its claws leave a numbness that spreads.

name: Bog Mummy
notes: It is slow, and the danger is being trapped in the mire with it.
desc: A body tanned black by centuries in a bog, a cord still tight on its neck. It strikes with hands as hard as wood.

name: Choir of the Drowned
notes: They stand in water to the waist and never come ashore.
desc: A row of pale figures who sing with water running from their mouths. The song fills lungs with the feeling of drowning.

name: Bell Ringer
notes: It tolls once for each hunter, and each toll is aimed.
desc: A hooded spirit that pulls on a rope reaching up into nothing. A bell sounds overhead and those who hear it falter.

name: Mirror Revenant
notes: It can step out of any reflecting surface in the room.
desc: A figure that lives in mirrors and looks like whoever last looked in. It cuts with shards of its own glass.

name: Hearthless One
notes: It goes for whoever carries the light or the fire.
desc: The ghost of someone who froze to death, blue and stiff, still reaching for warmth. It takes the heat from whoever it holds.

name: Storm Petrel Ghost
notes: It appears before bad weather and is strongest in rain.
desc: A great seabird made of spray and wind. It beats salt into the eyes of anyone on open ground.

name: Chain Warden
notes: He takes prisoners in place of kills when he can.
desc: A tall demon wound in iron chain, with a ring of keys at his belt. He binds hunters and drags them behind him.

name: Pit Gladiator
notes: It fights for a crowd even when there is none.
desc: A red, heavy demon with a net and a three pronged spear. It nets one hunter and stabs another.

name: Whisper Fiend
notes: It is rarely seen and speaks from just behind the shoulder.
desc: A thin shadow with a wide mouth and no eyes. It knows what each hunter regrets and says it aloud.

name: Ash Baroness
notes: She holds court in the middle of the fight and treats hunters as bad guests.
desc: A tall demon in a gown of grey ash that crumbles and reforms. She burns with a look and sets the floor to slow fire.

name: Flesh Tailor
notes: It mends its allies with pieces taken from its enemies.
desc: A hunched demon with fingers like needles and thread trailing from its sleeves. It sews wounds shut on its friends and open on its foes.

name: Bronze Bull
notes: It charges in straight lines and needs space to turn.
desc: A hollow bull of bronze with a fire burning in its belly. Its horns glow and steam pours from its nostrils.

name: Chess Rook
notes: It moves only in straight lines along the room.
desc: A stone tower on hidden wheels, twice a man's height. It slides in a straight line and crushes what stands there.

name: Glass Archer
notes: It shatters if struck hard, and the pieces cut.
desc: A slender figure of blown glass with a bow of the same. Its arrows break inside the wound.

name: Lead Sentinel
notes: It is very slow, and the room it guards is usually small.
desc: A squat figure of grey lead that leaves marks on the floor where it walks. It hits rarely and very hard.

name: Wax Double
notes: It copies the look of one hunter and the party must tell them apart.
desc: A wax figure that softens and takes the shape of whoever it touches. It fights with a copy of its victim's weapon.

name: Orrery Guardian
notes: Its spheres keep circling it and strike anyone who steps in.
desc: A frame of brass rings with metal spheres circling a central eye. It hurls the spheres and they return.

name: Frost Jotun Raider
notes: They raid for food and leave when they have enough.
desc: A blue skinned giant in furs with ice in his beard. He swings an axe cut from a glacier.

name: Fomorian Reaver
notes: Its one good eye is its weakness and it guards it.
desc: A twisted giant with one arm far larger than the other and one huge eye. Its stare weighs on the limbs.

name: Stone Thrower of the Pass
notes: It holds high ground and will not come down.
desc: A lean giant who sits above a mountain road with a pile of boulders. It can hit a rider at the far end of the pass.

name: Marsh Hydra
notes: A severed head grows back double unless the stump is burned.
desc: A swamp serpent with five heads on long necks. Each head bites on its own, and a cut neck grows back.

name: Verdigris Whelp
notes: It is young and proud and can be goaded into mistakes.
desc: A young dragon with scales the colour of old coins gone green. It breathes a line of acid that eats through metal.

name: Cockatrice Brood
notes: They nest in ruins among what look like statues.
desc: A flock of rooster headed lizards with leathery wings. Their peck stiffens flesh toward stone.

name: Thunder Drake
notes: It attacks in storms and stays in the air between passes.
desc: A blue grey drake that nests on storm struck peaks. Lightning runs along its jaws before it breathes.

name: Oathbreaker Captain
notes: His soldiers fight well while he stands and break when he falls.
desc: A mercenary commander in blackened plate with a torn banner. He fights at the centre of his company.

name: Coven Sister
notes: There are always three, and their curses are stronger together.
desc: A woman in a grey veil carrying a knotted cord. Each knot she ties closes a throat or opens a wound.

name: Gate Poacher
notes: He has trapped the ground before the hunters arrive.
desc: A hunter who takes monster parts without a licence, hung with snares and bottles. He shoots from behind his own traps.

name: Masked Duellist
notes: She fights one hunter at a time and salutes each.
desc: A fencer in a blank white mask and a long dark coat. She waits for an attack and answers it.

name: Briar Knight
notes: It guards a grove and will not leave it.
desc: An armoured figure grown from rose stems, with a helm of woven thorn. Its lance leaves thorns in the wound.

name: Corpse Lily
notes: It grows from the dead and the dead beneath it are its roots.
desc: A white lily as tall as a man that grows on graves. Its pollen brings a heavy, dangerous sleep.

name: Hanging Moss Elder
notes: It covers whole trees and a hunter may walk under it for some time.
desc: A grey beard of moss that hangs in long curtains. It drops over heads and its damp rots what it touches.

name: Leshy Warden
notes: He changes size at will and the forest paths move for him.
desc: A forest lord with bark for skin and a beard of grass, as tall as he chooses to be. He leads travellers astray and sets the wood on them.

name: Changeling Brute
notes: It was left in a cradle long ago and has grown wrong.
desc: A lumpish, grey skinned figure with a child's face on a huge body. It swings its fists without skill and with great strength.

name: Kelpie
notes: It appears as a fine horse and anyone who touches it sticks fast.
desc: A black horse with a dripping mane and weed in its tail. It carries its rider into deep water.

name: Corrosive Slick
notes: It ruins weapons that strike it.
desc: A thin, shining layer of liquid that spreads across a floor. It rises in a wave and eats metal and skin alike.

name: Bone Jelly
notes: The bones inside it are from earlier meals and it uses them as weapons.
desc: A clear mass with skeletons drifting inside it. It pushes sharpened bones out through its skin.

name: Magma Crawler
notes: It leaves burning ground behind it wherever it walks.
desc: A four legged shape of cooling lava with bright cracks in its back. It drips fire as it moves.

name: Hailstorm Sprite
notes: It is quick tempered and attacks anything that shouts.
desc: A small figure inside a whirling cloud of ice stones. It pelts everything around it.

name: Deep Angler
notes: In dark water its lure is the only light, and hunters walk toward it.
desc: A fish as large as a hut with a glowing stalk above its mouth. Prey that stares at the light does not see the teeth.

name: Reef Siren
notes: She sings ships onto rocks and hunters into the surf.
desc: A woman to the waist and a grey fish below, with a mouth full of small sharp teeth. Her song pulls listeners toward the water.

name: Faceless Choir
notes: It moves as one body and thinks with one mind.
desc: A cluster of grey figures joined at the shoulders, with smooth skin where their faces should be. They hum one note that empties the head.

name: Hollow Shepherd
notes: It herds hunters like sheep and separates the weakest.
desc: A tall thing in a shepherd's cloak with nothing under the hood. It carries a crook, and those it points at walk toward it.

name: Rime Wolf Alpha
notes: It howls to direct its pack, and the pack loses its order when the howl stops.
desc: A white wolf the size of a pony with frost on its muzzle. It breathes freezing mist and its pack attacks whoever the mist slows.

name: Thunder Hoof Aurochs
notes: Several of them together are a moving wall.
desc: A black wild ox taller than a man at the shoulder, with horns spread wide as a doorway. It runs down whatever is in front of it.

name: Manticore of the Wastes
notes: It keeps its distance until its spikes are spent.
desc: A red lion with a man's face, three rows of teeth and a tail of barbed spines. It throws its spines from the air and lands to feed.

name: Bunyip
notes: It is heard long before it is seen and attacks at the water's edge.
desc: A dark, heavy swamp beast with a dog's head, tusks and flippers. Its cry carries for miles, and it pulls prey into the billabong.

name: Sabre Tusk Stalker
notes: It attacks once from cover and retreats if the first strike fails.
desc: A tawny cat as heavy as a bull with fangs as long as daggers. It kills with one lunge to the throat.

name: Mountain Roc Fledgling
notes: It is young and clumsy and still large enough to lift a horse.
desc: A brown eagle chick already larger than a barn. It grabs what moves and drops what it cannot eat.

name: Amarok
notes: It hunts only those who travel alone, so it works to split the party.
desc: A wolf the size of a longhouse that hunts by itself on the ice. It takes anyone foolish enough to go out alone at night.

name: Hive Bull Beetle
notes: Smaller insects follow it and feed on what it pins.
desc: A black beetle the size of a wagon with a forked horn. It pins prey to the ground and holds it there.

name: Dread Centipede Elder
notes: It climbs walls and ceilings as easily as floors.
desc: A red centipede as long as a street with legs like sickles. It wraps around prey and bites until it stops moving.

name: Locust Prophet
notes: It speaks through the swarm, and the swarm is its body.
desc: A robed shape made of a million locusts with a hollow where the face should be. It strips fields and flesh alike.

name: Assassin Weaver
notes: It picks one target before the fight and ignores everyone else until that one is dead.
desc: A slim black spider the height of a man that moves without sound. It lowers itself on a single thread behind its victim.

name: Amber Hornet Guard
notes: They fly in formation and focus on one hunter at a time.
desc: A hornet the size of a horse with armour like polished amber. It stings on the wing and does not lose its stinger.

name: Revenant Marshal
notes: He has come back for one person and everyone else is in his way.
desc: A dead soldier in a rotted uniform with a bullet hole through his chest. He walks through wounds that should stop him.

name: Crypt Lich Acolyte
notes: It serves a greater master and flees to warn it.
desc: A robed skeleton with a hand of blue fire and a book chained to its belt. It casts from behind its dead servants.

name: Headless Rider
notes: Whoever hears their name called is its chosen target for the fight.
desc: A rider in black who carries his own head under one arm and a whip made from a spine. He calls a name and rides for that person.

name: Bone Colossus
notes: It is built of hundreds of skeletons and sheds them as it is damaged.
desc: A giant figure built from the bones of a whole battlefield. It sweeps hunters aside with an arm made of ribs.

name: Vampire Thrall Lord
notes: It is strong at night and looks for a way out by dawn.
desc: A pale noble in old fashioned dress with blood at the cuffs. It holds a victim with its eyes and feeds.

name: Nachzehrer
notes: It harms from its grave, and the fight is finding where it lies.
desc: A corpse that chews its own burial shroud in the grave. As it chews, the living it knew sicken and weaken.

name: Banshee of the Ford
notes: She names who will die and then tries to make it so.
desc: A grey woman who kneels at a river crossing washing bloodied clothes. Her scream drops grown hunters to their knees.

name: Dullahan's Hound
notes: It appears before its master and its bark is the warning.
desc: A black dog the size of a calf with eyes like lamps. Its bite is cold and leaves no mark.

name: Storm Hag
notes: She fights from above, and the weather is her weapon.
desc: A wild haired woman who rides the front of a thunderstorm. She throws lightning and drowns the ground beneath her.

name: Grief Eater
notes: It grows stronger each time a hunter falls.
desc: A thin, grey shape that follows funerals. It makes its victims relive their worst loss and feeds on what they feel.

name: Battlefield Echo
notes: It repeats one old battle and attacks anyone standing where the enemy stood.
desc: A line of soldiers made of mist who charge and fade and charge again. Their weapons are real when they strike.

name: Horned Executioner
notes: It announces whom it will kill next and does so if it can.
desc: A broad demon in a leather hood with ram horns curling through it. It names its victim before each swing.

name: Succubus Courtier
notes: She never strikes a blow and leaves when her puppets are gone.
desc: A beautiful figure with small horns and a smile that asks for trust. She turns hunters on each other.

name: Brazen Legionary
notes: They fight in ranks and are far weaker alone.
desc: A demon soldier in brass armour with a tall shield. They advance in step and push the enemy back.

name: Plague Vizier
notes: It wants the hunters to carry its sickness out of the gate, and may let them leave.
desc: A bloated demon in stained silks with a censer that leaks green smoke. Its presence sickens a whole room.

name: Wrath Imp Swarm
notes: Hunters they enrage attack whoever is nearest, friend or not.
desc: A cloud of red, shrieking imps no bigger than cats. Their bites fill the victim with blind anger.

name: Siege Automaton
notes: It was built to break walls and treats hunters as walls.
desc: A four legged machine of timber and iron with a ballista on its back. It shoots bolts the length of a man.

name: Mercury Golem
notes: It pours through gaps and reforms on the other side.
desc: A silver, liquid figure that changes shape as it moves. Its touch is poison.

name: Obsidian Sentinel
notes: Each blow against it sends sharp fragments flying.
desc: A statue of black volcanic glass with edges like knives. It cuts with every limb.

name: Bell Tower Golem
notes: It announces itself, so the hunters know what is coming and when.
desc: A walking tower of stone with a bronze bell in its chest. When the bell rings, the sound alone does harm.

name: Clockwork Inquisitor
notes: It asks a question before it attacks and punishes a lie.
desc: A tall machine in the shape of a robed judge with a face of turning dials. It burns a mark onto those it finds guilty.

name: Mountain Troll Chieftain
notes: He regenerates unless burned and his trolls take courage from him.
desc: A troll twice the size of the others with a crown of antlers and a whole pine for a club. He leads from the front.

name: Fire Jotun Smith
notes: He fights at his forge and uses what is on it.
desc: A giant with skin like dark iron and a beard of flame. He strikes with a smith's hammer still hot from the fire.

name: Cloud Shepherd
notes: He is not cruel, only careless of small things below him.
desc: A pale giant who walks the high slopes driving clouds like sheep. He hides the mountain in fog and steps where he pleases.

name: Basilisk Sire
notes: Hunters who meet its eyes stiffen, so they must fight looking away.
desc: An eight legged lizard with a crown of spines and eyes like dull lamps. What meets its gaze stiffens and what it breathes on withers.

name: Zmey Three Heads
notes: Each head must be dealt with, and it bargains when one is lost.
desc: A green dragon with three heads that speak in turn. It burns fields, demands tribute and fights with all three mouths.

name: Salt Drake
notes: It lives in salt flats and buries itself to wait.
desc: A white, crusted drake with eyes sunk deep in its skull. It breathes a cloud of stinging salt.

name: Verdant Wyrm
notes: The forest grows over those who stand still near it.
desc: A long green dragon with moss on its back and flowers growing between its scales. Its breath makes plants grow through whatever it touches.

name: Witch Hunter Zealot
notes: He believes hunters are tainted by the gates and cannot be reasoned with.
desc: A gaunt man in a wide hat with a crossbow and a belt of stakes. He hunts anyone touched by magic.

name: Blood Sworn Champion
notes: He fights harder the more he is hurt.
desc: A warrior stripped to the waist and painted red, with a two handed axe. He has sworn to die in this fight and intends to take company.

name: Gate Cult Hierophant
notes: He is mid ritual, and the fight has a clock on it.
desc: A masked priest in layered robes who worships what comes through the gates. He calls power from the gate itself.

name: Sharpshooter of the Ashen Company
notes: She takes one careful shot each round from as far away as the map allows.
desc: A woman with a long rifle wrapped in cloth and a patch over one eye. She shoots the hand that holds the weapon.

name: Elder Oak Walker
notes: It is slow to wake and should be roused by fire or axes.
desc: An oak that walks, its face a knot in the trunk and its arms heavy boughs. It brings its whole weight down on what angers it.

name: Blood Thorn Thicket
notes: It is the terrain as much as an enemy, and moving through it costs blood.
desc: A wall of red thorned briar that drinks from what it cuts. It shoots thorns in every direction.

name: Fungal Sovereign
notes: The corpses in its cavern stand up as its soldiers.
desc: A mushroom the size of a chapel with a slow pulse of light in its gills. Its spores grow inside the living and move the dead.

name: Erlking's Huntsman
notes: He hunts for sport and gives his quarry a head start.
desc: A tall rider in green with antlers on his helm and a horn at his side. His arrows leave no wound and a numbness that spreads.

name: Baba of the Bone Fence
notes: She keeps bargains to the letter and punishes rudeness.
desc: An ancient woman with iron teeth who flies in a mortar and steers with a pestle. Her fence is made of the bones of visitors.

name: Nuckelavee
notes: It cannot cross fresh running water.
desc: A skinless horse and rider grown together as one body, with black blood moving in yellow veins. Its breath wilts crops and sickens people.

name: Elder Pitch Mass
notes: It fills corridors from wall to wall.
desc: A black mass large enough to fill a room. It dissolves anything it rolls over.

name: Quicksilver Tide
notes: It moves faster than anything its size should.
desc: A silver flood that runs uphill and around corners. It washes over a group and leaves them sick.

name: Tempest Elemental
notes: It throws hunters about the room and never holds still.
desc: A tall whirlwind with a core of lightning and a face that comes and goes. It lifts hunters and throws them.

name: Glacier Heart
notes: It freezes the ground as it advances.
desc: A slab of living ice the size of a house with a blue glow at its centre. Everything near it slows and stiffens.

name: Tidal Kraken Spawn
notes: It attacks ships and shores and retreats to deep water when hurt.
desc: A young kraken with arms as thick as masts. It wraps a boat or a hunter and squeezes.

name: Abyssal Eel
notes: It hunts in total darkness and is drawn to light.
desc: A black eel as long as a ship with needle teeth and sparks along its sides. Its bite carries a shock that stops the heart for a beat.

name: Eye of the Sunken Vault
notes: It watches for several rounds before it acts, and it remembers.
desc: A single great eye in a nest of wet cords, fixed to a ceiling. Whatever it looks at for long enough begins to come apart.

name: Many Jointed Stalker
notes: It fits into spaces far too small for it.
desc: A tall, thin thing with too many elbows and knees. It unfolds from cracks and cupboards and reaches a long way.

name: Nemean Pride Lord
notes: Ordinary blades skid off its hide, so the hunters need another way.
desc: A lion as large as a war elephant with a hide like beaten gold. Edged weapons slide off it and it kills with a blow of the paw.

name: Storm Roc
notes: It fights from the air and lands only to finish a kill.
desc: An eagle large enough to carry off an elephant, with storm clouds trailing from its wings. Each wingbeat sounds like thunder.

name: Mapinguari
notes: Its smell alone sickens, and it is strong enough to fight through almost any wound.
desc: A red furred giant sloth with one eye and a second mouth in its belly. Its stink drops hunters before it reaches them.

name: Ahuizotl
notes: It mimics a crying child to draw its victim to the water.
desc: A black, dog sized water beast with a hand at the end of its tail. It grabs from the shallows and holds its prey under.

name: Glutton Bear of the North
notes: It keeps eating during the fight and does not stop for wounds.
desc: A bear grown fat and huge on everything it has met. It swallows what it bites off.

name: Thunderbird Fledgling
notes: Clouds gather where it hunts, and it leaves if the sky clears.
desc: A young bird of the storm with feathers that crackle. Lightning leaps from its eyes when it blinks.

name: Empress Scorpion
notes: She buries herself between attacks and strikes from below.
desc: A black scorpion as long as a temple hall with a sting like a ship's anchor. One sting stops a hunter where they stand.

name: War Hive Juggernaut
notes: Smaller insects ride on its back and shoot from there.
desc: A beetle the size of a fortress gate, bred to break lines. It walks through walls and formations alike.

name: Razor Wing Swarm Mother
notes: She keeps to the centre of her swarm and is hard to pick out.
desc: A dragonfly longer than a boat with wings like sheets of mica. A storm of smaller ones follows her and cuts whatever they pass.

name: Moth of the Last Light
notes: Lights go out one by one as it approaches.
desc: A grey moth as wide as a house that feeds on flame. Where it flies, lamps die and people fall asleep.

name: Grave Knight Commander
notes: He fights with skill and patience and keeps his dead soldiers in formation.
desc: A towering knight in black plate with cold fire behind his visor. He commands a company of the dead and fights at its head.

name: Lich of the Sealed Library
notes: It cannot be killed for good while its hidden vessel survives.
desc: A robed skeleton with jewels for eyes, seated among thousands of books. It has had centuries to prepare for visitors.

name: Gashadokuro
notes: The only warning is a ringing in the ears.
desc: A skeleton fifteen times the height of a man, built from the bones of the starved. It picks people up and bites off their heads.

name: Strigoi Elder
notes: It has two hearts and both must be dealt with.
desc: A red haired, long dead noble with a second row of teeth. It leaves its grave at night to feed on its own kin.

name: Plague Cart Driver
notes: The cart never stops moving, and what falls in its path is added to the load.
desc: A hooded figure who leads a cart piled with bodies. The sickness that killed them rides with him.

name: Wild Hunt Outrider
notes: The whole hunt follows behind, so this is the first of many.
desc: A ghostly rider on a horse of storm cloud, ahead of a baying pack. He marks the quarry for those who follow.

name: Mourning Queen
notes: Her court of shades absorbs blows meant for her.
desc: The ghost of a queen in a black veil, attended by the shades of her household. Her grief has soaked into the walls.

name: Gallows Tree Spirit
notes: Every person hanged from it now fights for it.
desc: A dead tree with rope ends on every bough and faces in its bark. It hangs whoever comes beneath it.

name: Fog of the Lost Fleet
notes: It covers a whole harbour, and the fight is to find its heart.
desc: A grey sea fog with the shapes of sailors moving inside it. Those who breathe it taste salt water.

name: Tyrant of the Burning Pit
notes: It commands a legion and expects the hunters to kneel.
desc: A winged demon three times a man's height with a crown of flame. It rules a layer of the pit and has never lost.

name: Marid of the Black Tide
notes: It grants a wish to anyone who beats it and twists the wish.
desc: A blue skinned spirit of the deep sea, vast and proud, wearing a storm for a robe. It raises the sea wherever it stands.

name: Ifrit Sultan's Blade
notes: He is bound to a master and fights only as far as the binding demands.
desc: A tall figure of smokeless fire in golden armour with a curved sword in each hand. He moves like flame on oil.

name: Rakshasa Deceiver
notes: It wears the shape of someone trusted until the moment it strikes.
desc: A tiger headed sorcerer with hands that bend backward. It appears as a friend and feeds on the confusion.

name: Wendigo
notes: It grows with each kill and is never full.
desc: A gaunt giant with ash grey skin stretched over bone and antlers on its skull. It smells of rot and is always starving.

name: Bone Fiend Inquisitor
notes: It interrogates in the middle of a fight and takes pleasure in the answers.
desc: A tall, skeletal demon with dry skin and a scorpion's tail. It hooks a victim close and questions it.

name: Colossus of the Harbour
notes: It has one sealed vein at the heel, and that is its only weak point.
desc: A bronze giant that once stood astride a harbour mouth. It crushes ships and bleeds molten metal when cut.

name: Adamant Juggernaut
notes: It cannot turn quickly and never stops moving forward.
desc: A wheeled fortress of dark metal with no visible seams. It rolls forward and flattens what does not move.

name: Astral Loom
notes: It reweaves the room as it fights, so doors and walls change place.
desc: A vast loom that weaves by itself with threads of light. It pulls threads out of living things.

name: Sphinx of Black Basalt
notes: It asks a riddle first and attacks only on a wrong answer.
desc: A stone lion with a calm human face, lying across a doorway. It speaks slowly and strikes without warning.

name: Thousand Blade Engine
notes: It fills a corridor from wall to wall and advances at a walk.
desc: A machine of spinning arms, each ending in a sword. There is no safe side to stand on.

name: Storm Jotun Jarl
notes: His hall is a mountain top and the weather there obeys him.
desc: A giant king with a grey beard full of lightning and a hammer the size of a house. Storms follow his moods.

name: Hundred Handed Sentinel
notes: It can attack every hunter in reach in the same moment.
desc: A giant with fifty heads and a hundred arms, set to guard a prison below the earth. It throws a hillside of rocks at once.

name: Earth Shaker Titanling
notes: It is a child of something much larger and it cries out when hurt.
desc: A young titan the height of a tower, clumsy and curious. Its footsteps open cracks in the ground.

name: Ancient Frost Wyrm
notes: It has slept under the ice for an age and wakes hungry.
desc: A white dragon as long as a river with scales like plates of old ice. Its breath freezes a lake to the bottom.

name: Sand Wyrm Devourer
notes: The ground trembles before it surfaces, which gives the hunters one round to move.
desc: A wingless dragon that swims through dunes with a mouth like a cave. It surfaces under its prey and swallows it.

name: Venom Naga Queen
notes: She guards a treasure and prefers to talk before she fights.
desc: A serpent with a woman's face and a jewelled hood, coiled on a heap of gold. She spits venom and holds prey with her eyes.

name: Skyfire Drake Matron
notes: She protects a nest and attacks anything within sight of it.
desc: A red drake with long narrow wings and scorch marks along her jaw. She burns a line across the ground in each pass.

name: Archmage of the Ninth Circle
notes: He has prepared for this fight and has an answer ready for the obvious plan.
desc: An old man in plain grey robes whose shadow moves a moment after he does. He has broken every rule of his order.

name: Fallen Hunter Ace
notes: She fights like an S rank and knows every trick the party does.
desc: A famous hunter lost in a gate years ago, still in her guild colours. She does not recognise anyone.

name: Iron Saint
notes: He believes he is saving those he kills.
desc: A huge man in iron armour riveted shut, with scripture cut into every plate. He prays aloud as he swings.

name: Night Market Assassin
notes: He is hired for one target and leaves when the job is done.
desc: A plain, forgettable man in a grey scarf. He passes close, and his victim falls some steps later.

name: Grove Mother
notes: The whole forest is her body, and every tree in it is an arm.
desc: An enormous tree with a woman's shape in its trunk and roots that run for miles. Everything that grows nearby obeys her.

name: Carrion Orchid Colossus
notes: What it swallows is digested slowly and can be cut out alive.
desc: A flower the height of a tower with a throat lined with teeth. It smells of rotting meat and swallows what comes close.

name: Queen of the Hollow Hill
notes: Time runs differently in her hall, and she offers food that binds whoever eats it.
desc: A tall, pale queen crowned with silver thorns in a hall under a hill. Her guests dance until their feet are bone.

name: Dullahan
notes: He stops only for gold, which he cannot bear to look upon.
desc: A headless rider on a black horse who holds his own grinning head aloft like a lantern. Where he stops, someone dies.

name: Devouring Tide
notes: It fills a whole cavern, and the fight is a retreat through it.
desc: A flood of grey slime deep enough to drown in. It rises and falls like a tide.

name: Volcano Heart
notes: The room heats each round until no one can stay in it.
desc: A giant of black rock with a core of white hot magma. Lava runs from its joints.

name: Void Wind
notes: It cannot be seen, so describe the silence where it passes.
desc: A moving emptiness where air should be. It pulls the breath out of lungs.

name: Leviathan Calf
notes: Its parent is near, and killing it has consequences.
desc: A young sea monster as long as a warship, grey and barnacled. It breaks boats with its tail.

name: Charybdis Maw
notes: It does not move, and the fight is against being pulled in.
desc: A ring of teeth at the bottom of a whirlpool wide enough to take a fleet. It swallows the sea three times a day.

name: Dreaming Polyp
notes: Hunters near it fall asleep on their feet and fight in a dream.
desc: A pale, pulsing growth the size of a house, fixed to a cavern wall. Those near it dream what it dreams.

name: Seraph of Ashes
notes: It was sent to cleanse the gate and sees no difference between monsters and hunters.
desc: A six winged figure of pale fire with its face hidden behind two wings. Its light blinds and its voice burns.

name: Fallen Watcher
notes: It offers knowledge in place of a fight, and the knowledge does harm.
desc: A tall, scarred figure with the stumps of wings, bound in broken chain. It taught mankind things it should not have.

name: Behemoth of the Reed Sea
notes: It ignores small wounds, and the ground breaks wherever it walks.
desc: A beast the size of a hill with bones like bronze tubes and a tail like a cedar. It drinks rivers and walks through city walls.

name: Fenris Get
notes: It grows through the fight and no binding holds it for long.
desc: A black wolf whose back reaches the tops of the pines, with a broken fetter on one leg. Its jaws open wide enough to take a house.

name: Simurgh of the Barren Peak
notes: It has seen the world end three times and can be reasoned with by the wise.
desc: A vast bird with a dog's head and copper feathers, old beyond counting. Its wings darken a valley.

name: Grootslang
notes: It will bargain for gems, and it keeps its cave full of them.
desc: A serpent as thick as a river with the head and tusks of an elephant. It lives in a cave of diamonds and drags prey into the dark.

name: Akhlut
notes: It hunts on ice and in water alike, and its tracks lead to the sea and stop.
desc: A great black and white beast, part wolf and part whale. It comes out of the sea to hunt on the ice.

name: Nian
notes: Loud noise, fire and the colour red drive it back.
desc: A horned lion with a flat face and a wide mouth that comes down from the mountain at midwinter. It eats whole villages in a night.

name: Piasa of the Bluffs
notes: It nests on cliffs above rivers and takes one victim at a time.
desc: A winged beast with a bearded face, antlers and a tail long enough to wrap twice around its body. It takes hunters off the riverbank.

name: Brood Empress
notes: The hive is her body and it does not stop while she lives.
desc: A pale, swollen queen the size of a cathedral, fixed in a chamber of wax. Thousands of her young pour from the walls.

name: Root Eater Larva
notes: It is only the young of something, and it is already the size of a hill.
desc: A white grub as long as a mountain road with a mouth that grinds stone to dust. It eats its way through the roots of the world.

name: Death's Head Reaper
notes: It marks one hunter with its wing pattern and hunts that one first.
desc: A moth winged mantis as tall as a tower with a skull shape on its back. It harvests the living like wheat.

name: Carapace Knight Paragon
notes: They are the common soldiers of an S rank hive, and there are many.
desc: An upright insect in natural armour like lacquered plate, carrying a glaive of its own shed shell. It fights with drilled precision.

name: Silk Oracle
notes: She reads the vibrations of her web and knows where each hunter will step.
desc: A blind, white spider at the centre of a web that fills a canyon. She knows what will touch her web before it does.

name: First Vampire's Shadow
notes: It is only the shadow its master left behind, and it is still this strong.
desc: A tall darkness in the outline of a cloaked noble, with two red points for eyes. It drinks without touching.

name: Emperor in the Jade Shroud
notes: His clay army stands ready in the pits around him.
desc: An emperor buried in a suit of jade plates sewn with gold wire. He has waited two thousand years to rule again.

name: Gravelord Titan
notes: Every graveyard it crosses joins its body.
desc: A giant built from the earth and stones of a hundred cemeteries, with coffins showing in its sides. The dead fall out of it as it walks.

name: Reaper's Apprentice
notes: It is still learning the trade and it is careless.
desc: A thin figure in a cowl too large for it, carrying a scythe taller than itself. It cuts the thread of a life with care.

name: Bone Dragon Risen
notes: It remembers being alive and hates what killed it.
desc: The skeleton of a great dragon moving with no flesh at all. Grey dust pours from its jaws where fire once did.

name: King of the Wild Hunt
notes: He hunts until dawn or until his quarry is dead, and he chooses his quarry.
desc: An antlered king on an eight legged horse at the head of a host of ghosts. He hunts across the winter sky.

name: Mother of Storms
notes: She is the storm itself, and there is no part of the sky that is not hers.
desc: A woman's shape in the turning clouds, miles across. Every storm of the season is one of her daughters.

name: Nameless Dread
notes: It has no form, and hunters know it is near only by their fear.
desc: A presence with no body that fills a place like cold air. Animals die of fright when it passes.

name: Ancestor Wrath
notes: It is the anger of a whole bloodline, and one hunter in the party may be kin.
desc: A towering ghost made of many faces, all of one family. It punishes those who shamed the dead.

name: Echo of a Dead God
notes: It is only an echo and does not know its god is gone.
desc: A faint golden outline of something vast, repeating one gesture. Its voice still carries the weight of law.

name: Prince of the Sixth Pit
notes: He offers every hunter a contract first, and he honours it.
desc: A crowned demon in armour of black glass, courteous and enormous. He has bought more souls than he has taken.

name: Ifrit Sultan
notes: He was made of fire before men were made of clay and has not forgiven them.
desc: A giant of smokeless flame on a throne of brass. He rules a city that burns and is never consumed.

name: Lady of Flies
notes: Every wound near her festers within moments.
desc: A veiled demon whose gown is a living mass of flies. Where she walks, food rots and wounds turn.

name: Oni Warlord
notes: He loves strong drink and a good fight and respects anyone who gives him either.
desc: A red skinned ogre demon with two horns and a studded iron club as long as a mast. He laughs as he fights.

name: Legion Standard Bearer
notes: Every demon near the standard fights harder, so it is the first target.
desc: A demon in scorched plate who carries the banner of a hell legion. The legion does not break while the banner stands.

name: Tempter at the Crossroads
notes: He never attacks first and is always willing to deal.
desc: A well dressed stranger who waits where two roads meet at midnight. He gives people what they ask for.

name: Talos Reforged
notes: It circles what it guards three times a day and never sleeps.
desc: A giant of living bronze that heats itself red and holds its enemies against its chest. It guards an island.

name: Engine of the Forgotten War
notes: It still follows orders from a war that ended ages ago.
desc: A walking fortress of iron on six legs, bristling with guns. It has not been told the war is over.

name: God Forged Sentinel
notes: It tests those who approach and lets the worthy pass.
desc: A flawless silver statue of a warrior, twice a man's height. It was made to guard a door and has never been passed.

name: Clockwork Leviathan
notes: It must surface to wind its springs, and that is the time to strike.
desc: A mechanical whale of brass and glass that swims through the earth as if it were water. It swallows what it rams.

name: Surtling Lord
notes: He carries a sword brighter than the sun and is waiting for the last day.
desc: A black giant wreathed in flame who stands at the border of a land of fire. His sword lights the sky.

name: Mountain That Walks
notes: It moves once in a generation and does not notice what it steps on.
desc: A giant so large that forests grow on its shoulders. It is taken for a mountain until it stands.

name: Frost Jotun King
notes: He prefers contests of wit and cheats at them.
desc: A giant king on a throne of ice with a crown of icicles. Winter never ends in his hall.

name: Cyclops Forgemaster
notes: He makes weapons for gods and tests them on visitors.
desc: A one eyed giant with burn scarred arms, working a forge inside a volcano. He throws what he is working on.

name: Elder Wyrm of the Deep Hoard
notes: It knows every coin in its hoard and the worth of every hunter.
desc: A red gold dragon grown too large to leave its cavern, lying on the treasure of dead kingdoms. It is old, patient and cruel.

name: Storm Dragon Ascendant
notes: It never lands, so the fight must be brought up to it.
desc: A long blue dragon that lives inside thunderclouds. It is rarely seen whole and lightning marks where it has been.

name: Plague Dragon
notes: The land for miles around its lair is dead.
desc: A sickly green dragon with holes rotted through its wings. It cannot fly far, and nothing lives where it rests.

name: Zilant Twin
notes: There are two of them, and they fight as one mind.
desc: A grey dragon with a bird's legs and a serpent's tail. It is never without its twin.

name: Cuelebre of the Cave Mouth
notes: Its scales grow harder with age, and this one is very old.
desc: A winged serpent with bat wings and scales as thick as shields. It guards a cave of treasure and enchanted captives.

name: Hero of a Fallen Age
notes: He fights with honour and expects the same.
desc: A warrior in ancient bronze, taller than men are now, with a spear no one living could lift. He was sung about before writing.

name: Sorcerer King
notes: He has ruled for nine hundred years and has outlived every assassin.
desc: A crowned man with a young face and very old eyes, seated above a city of slaves. He paid for his power with his people.

name: Monarch's Executioner
notes: She kills only those she is sent for and feels nothing about it.
desc: A woman in a black hood with a sword that has no point. She has never needed a second stroke.

name: World Root Dryad
notes: She is the voice of the first tree and speaks for everything that grows.
desc: A woman of living wood whose hair is a canopy of leaves. She stands where the oldest root breaks the ground.

name: Rot That Walks
notes: It is a forest's death given legs, and it spreads to whatever it touches.
desc: A shambling hill of fungus, dead wood and rot. Green things die where it passes.

name: Winter King
notes: He rules half the year and wants the other half.
desc: A pale lord in armour of ice with a crown of bare branches. Wherever he sits it is midwinter.

name: Lord of Misrule
notes: Nothing near him works as it should, for either side.
desc: A capering figure in motley with a mask that changes expression. Where he goes, order fails.

name: Primordial Tar
notes: The bones of ancient beasts drift inside it.
desc: A lake of black tar that has swallowed living things since before there were people. It moves slowly and reaches far.

name: Living Maelstrom
notes: It is a storm that learned to want things.
desc: A column of wind, water and lightning that reaches from the sea to the clouds. Ships vanish when it leans toward them.

name: Heart of the Mountain
notes: The cavern itself is its body, and the walls close in.
desc: A giant of veined rock and crystal seated in the deepest chamber of a mountain. When it moves, the range shakes.

name: Kraken of the Black Trench
notes: Sailors take its back for an island.
desc: A squid the size of an island with arms that can reach the masthead of any ship. It pulls fleets under whole.

name: Island Turtle Ancient
notes: It demands tribute from ships and lets those who pay pass.
desc: A turtle whose shell is a small island with trees on it. It breathes steam that cooks a crew in their armour.

name: Herald from the Dark Star
notes: It came ahead of something else and is preparing the way.
desc: A shape that hurts to look at, with angles that do not add up and a colour with no name. It arrived from the sky and announces something worse.

name: Flesh Cathedral
notes: It has grown through a whole building, and the hunters fight it from inside.
desc: A building of living tissue with ribs for arches and a slow heartbeat in the walls. It prays to itself with a thousand mouths.

name: Archon of the Shut Gate
notes: It was set to guard a way and no plea will move it.
desc: A four faced guardian with a turning sword of fire, set before a gate no mortal may enter. It has stood there since the gate was closed.

name: Throne Wheel
notes: It does not speak and it does not stop turning.
desc: A wheel within a wheel, each rim set with eyes, burning as it turns in the air. To be seen by it is to be judged.

name: Psychopomp
notes: It has come for one soul only and will leave when it has it.
desc: A quiet, grey winged figure with a lantern and a ledger. It guides the dead and does not like to be kept waiting.
